verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only paid access: a card-required, pay-per-use tier at ¥98 per credit with 100 credits per run, and a Pro plan at ¥150,000/month. Nothing documents a free tier, free credits or a trial. Downloadable sample reports are an adjacent resource, not a way to try the product itself.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can try the product meaningfully on a free tier or trial
